_usage: Branching conversation. Three meaningful states, two paths, two different endings.
One ending gives the player an item via a blabber:command action.
@s in commands refers to the player. @interlocutor refers to the NPC.
Every non-end state fires nod_up_down on entry by default (the NPC nods on each
new line) — this only works cleanly for single-NPC dialogues, since @interlocutor
is one fixed entity; for a two-NPC scene where the text alternates speakers, swap
the 'as @interlocutor' selector for an explicit per-NPC selector on each state, or
drop the action on lines spoken by whichever NPC isn't @interlocutor. Delete the
action entirely on any state where a nod would look wrong.
Replace all bracketed placeholders before use, including <npc_key> (this NPC's
key from _npcs/npcs/registry.json) in both end states below — these resume the
NPC's routine if it was paused (see _templates/npcs/resume_routine.mcfunction
and _templates/npcs/end_with_gift.mcfunction). Only needed if this NPC has
a roaming movement mode; otherwise simplify end_with_gift back to a plain 'give'

state_1.text: [NPC opening — presents the player with a choice]

choices.text: [Player choice A — leads to reward path]
[Player choice B — leads to refusal path]

state_2a.text: [NPC response to choice A — positive / accepting]

state_2b.text: [NPC response to choice B — negative / closing]
